items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He came in and played and I think Roy Haynes came and played with him, Bunky Green, and Jay Peters

ctx.x: Wow, wow. So I was thinking now with... Because Dizzy - we’re talking about Dizzy - your first encounter with Dizzy as the Jazz Showcase, was that late forties or in the fifties?
No. The Showcase was - When I was at the North Park, that was in the sixties.
Sixties, ok. I got my chronology off there.
